title: The 27th International Conference on Condensed Matter Nuclear Science
description:
The conference will cover a wide range of topics related to Condensed Matter Nuclear Science, including but not limited to:Heat Production
Transmutations
Electrochemical Experiments
Hot Gas Experiments
Beam Experiments
Plasma Experiments
Artificial Intelligence (AI) in low energy nuclear reactions (LENR)
Material Studies
Theoretical Studies
Related Studies

title: Russell Winter
description:
I’m going to show basically every aspect of what I know and how I do things. I will post about stuff and include actual screen shots, pictures, statements, and documents. Maybe some videos of day in the life or the joys of defense contracting...

I’ll break down the inner workings of not just turning raw metal into finished tooling or parts, but also working with customers, banks, lawyers, the government, family/business and family-business dynamics, personal/business finances, and raising a young family through this.
